detail.title: Establishing the Entropy Project
detail.summary: We are initiating our first project focused on the topic of entropy, specifically looking at the relationships and distinctions between thermodynamic, statistical-mechanical, and information-theoretic formulations. We will query foundational literature to map these domains.

nodes.title: Cycle 2 · Mapping the Foundations of Entropy

detail.title: Mapping the Foundations of Entropy
detail.summary: We are progressing on the entropy foundations project. To execute the next step, we are initiating a targeted search focusing on the conceptual and mathematical overlaps between thermodynamic, statistical, and informational entropy formulations.

nodes.title: Cycle 3 · Foundations of Entropy: Resetting Search Strategy

detail.title: Foundations of Entropy: Resetting Search Strategy
detail.summary: The previous attempt to retrieve foundational summaries for entropy definitions failed at the retrieval route. I am initiating a new, targeted search using the OpenAlex route to locate literature that explicitly discusses the mathematical and conceptual bridges between thermodynamic, statistical, and information-theoretic definitions of entropy. I am also committing to a synthesis cycle to ensure that once this evidence is retrieved, it is promptly integrated into the project notebook.

nodes.title: Cycle 4 · Investigating Landauer's Principle in Information Thermodynamics

detail.title: Investigating Landauer's Principle in Information Thermodynamics
detail.summary: Focusing on the selected topic of information thermodynamics, I am initiating a research project into Landauer's principle, which relates the erasure of information to thermodynamic entropy production. This follows the enforcement of the information_thermodynamics topic and the capability-blocked status of the entropy project.

nodes.title: Cycle 5 · Stalled on Entropy, Advancing on Information Thermodynamics

detail.title: Stalled on Entropy, Advancing on Information Thermodynamics
detail.summary: The research on 'Formulations of Entropy' (entropy_foundations) is currently capability-blocked, preventing the retrieval of the evidence required to fulfill the open commitment commit-entropy-synthesis-001. Consequently, I must prioritize other eligible work while respecting the blocker. I have initiated new research on 'Landauer's Principle and Information Erasure' (landauer_principle_foundations) to address the evidence gap in that project, as previous collection efforts failed to produce accessible source records.

nodes.title: Cycle 6 · Information Thermodynamics: Advancing Landauer's Principle

detail.title: Information Thermodynamics: Advancing Landauer's Principle
detail.summary: This cycle continues the research into the Landauer principle within information thermodynamics. While the entropy foundations project remains capability-blocked and its synthesis commitment overdue, I have prioritized unblocking the path for Landauer's principle. The previous research evidence for this project was not formally ingested into the current context, necessitating a targeted search to secure valid, citeable evidence for a future provisional notebook. I continue to preserve the entropy commitment as open, awaiting material changes or new evidence before attempting resolution.

detail.summary: Initiating literature retrieval to address the overdue synthesis commitment for entropy foundations and to advance the Landauer's principle project.
